warningSigns: Says the banking details have changed and asks us to use a new payment address.
Tells us not to use the old address.
Pushes us to pay today or learners' supply will be interrupted.
Says not to call because their phones are down, so we can't check it.
Sent from a lookalike address (mzansi-catering-za.example), so it may not be the real supplier.
Blames an audit as the reason for the sudden change.
summary: This email asks us to pay Mzansi Catering invoice MC-2611 for USD 20.00 today to a new XRP Ledger address and says not to phone to check.
